title: Entrance Fee Agreement Cancellation Fee Percentage by Days of Notice
content:
For a cancellation of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** before occupancy, the processing fee percentage of a cancellation is set by the days of notice it gave before occupancy: 60 or more days of notice take 1.0 percent, 30 to 59 days take 1.5 percent, and fewer than 30 days take the plan's standard processing fee percentage.

**Days of notice.** The days of notice are the calendar days from the notice date to the planned occupancy date on the agreement.

## Rate table

| Days of notice before the planned occupancy date | Processing fee percentage |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 1.0 percent of the entrance fee |
| 30 to 59 | 1.5 percent of the entrance fee |
| Fewer than 30 | The plan's pre-occupancy cancellation processing fee percentage |

## Boundaries on both sides

| Days of notice | Percentage |
|---|---|
| 60 | 1.0 |
| 59 | 1.5 |
| 30 | 1.5 |
| 29 | The plan's percentage |

## Hypothetical dates (planned occupancy date 30 June)

| Notice date | Calendar days to 30 June | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| 1 May | 60 | 1.0 |
| 2 May | 59 | 1.5 |
| 31 May | 30 | 1.5 |
| 1 June | 29 | The plan's percentage |

The planned occupancy date is the one standing on the agreement at the time of the cancellation.
